prompt:
You are a hardware-debug illustrator. Draw ONE technical signal-flow diagram (dark background, light labels) explaining a RISC-V RTL failure.
Case: mut-pilot-02
Failing-trace sha256 (first 16 hex): 185f5926fed1da6e
Verbatim diagnosis from the debug agent:
Loopback read via reg_dat_do returned 0xff (~0) instead of 0xa5 because recv_buf_valid never asserted with recv_buf_data. Reset leaves recv_state in 1 so receiver starts in half-bit wait using recv_divcnt vs cfg_divider while ser_rx is idle high instead of waiting in state 0 for start. The false start consumes timing and the real start bit is missed, so no byte is framed.
Diagram MUST show: the failing signal path named in the diagnosis, the wrong value vs the expected value, and the single RTL line to fix. Annotate the trace hash 185f5926fed1da6e in a corner as provenance. No decorative elements, no invented signals.
